name: ring_beam_tri3
description: Simply supported 4 x 1.5 beam with two openings (r=0.25) at (1,0.75) and (3,0.75), each surrounded by a passive solid ring 0.25<=r<=0.35 that counts toward the volume fraction
supports: Lower edge: pin ux=uy=0 on 0<=x<=0.1, roller uy=0 on 3.9<=x<=4
loads: Uniform downward traction on the upper edge, 1.9<=x<=2.1, resultant Fy=-1
passive_elements: fixed_density: 1 on the 1,868 ring triangles, NaN (designable) elsewhere
load_discretization: Consistent line integral of uniform edge traction
